summary: Enova International, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its indirect subsidiary NetCredit Combined Receivables B, LLC issued $300.9 million in securitization notes (2026-A) backed by consumer installment loans. The notes are unregistered, sold under Rule 144A, with fixed coupons of 5.88% (Class A), 7.68% (Class B), and 10.64% (Class C), maturing September 2032. Proceeds will acquire receivables, fund a reserve, and pay fees. The notes are not guaranteed by Enova. This is a routine financing transaction, not a special situation. What to watch: covenant compliance and loan performance affecting the securitization.
